title: UAT-12643: Suspected North Korea-aligned actor blends blockchain resilience with targeted infostealing
description: The UAT-12643 threat group, suspected to be aligned with North Korea, targets cryptocurrency holders, gaming platform users, and VoIP software operators primarily in Europe. It uses multiple malware payloads including Overlord RAT, Good Game infostealer, and a clipboard hijacker for cryptocurrencies. Overlord RAT features a novel command-and-control resilience method by embedding encrypted server URLs in Solana blockchain transaction memos. The campaign targets documents in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese, indicating a focus on finance staff, VoIP operators, and cryptocurrency users. The tactics overlap with known North Korean APT groups such as Lazarus Group and UNK_DeadDrop cluster.
